capabilities: translate foreign-language markdown files in reading mode
configure CSS selectors for which elements get translated
exclude elements such as inline code from translation
disambiguation: Not the Immersive Translate browser extension; it applies Immersive Translate to markdown files inside Obsidian's reading view.
extras: Settings currently only expose selectors and excludeSelectors options, and any setting change takes effect only after relaunch.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read notes written in a foreign language with a translation shown alongside the original text.
summary: Translation plugin that renders foreign-language translations of markdown files in Obsidian's reading view, built on Immersive Translate.
